goal: Allow pruned wallets to re-import transactions spending from the wallet after removing pruned funds
Fixes incorrect balance reporting when re-importing those transactions
reviewability: Waiting on author to address open review feedback on the test suite
agreement: Support because it marks spent UTXOs properly and restores correct balances (Bicaru20)
General approval of the fix and test coverage (achow101, Bicaru20)
Nonblocking suggestion: verify balance equality before removal and after re-import (Bicaru20)
